app.name: ALDEA World
app.tagline: The autonomous world where every character is born with a soul.

common.comingSoon: This screen arrives in an upcoming phase.

kit.title: Design kit
kit.intro: ALDEA World base components on top of the design system tokens.
kit.panelBody: This is where the village's souls are born. Choose your class and the fire will decide your tribe.
kit.dialogBody: Your tribe comes from the hash of a future Base block: nobody, not even the team, knows it when you ask to be born.
kit.toastError: The embers did not answer. Try again.
kit.tabCensusBody: Total population, gestating, 11 classes and 5 tribes.

auth.failed: We couldn't confirm your identity. Let's try again.

keys.title: Your keys
keys.addAnother: Add another way to sign in: if you lose this one, you don't lose your soul.
keys.linkOwner: Link a wallet as an owner of my account

error.step_up_required: For your safety, confirm it's you before adding this key.
error.link_belongs_to_other_soul: This key belongs to another soul. If both are yours, you can merge them.
error.last_login_method: It's your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.
error.controller_link: This key owns your account on Base; it can't be removed yet.
error.soul_anchored: The other soul was already born in the village: it can't be merged.
error.no_wallet: We couldn't find a wallet in this browser.

townCenter.title: Town Center
townCenter.pickAClass: Pick a class to be born
townCenter.beFirst: Be the first soul in the village.
townCenter.pathCut: The path to the Town Center is cut off. Let's try again.

birth.title: Your birth
birth.choosing: The embers are choosing their color…
birth.rekindled: The embers rekindled, a few more seconds.
birth.failed: We couldn't complete your birth. Your request is safe; try again.
birth.howDrawnText: Your tribe comes from the fingerprint of a Base block that does not exist yet when you ask to be born. Nobody, not even the team, can know it in advance.
birth.bornInto: You were born into the tribe
birth.named: Your soul now has a name.

errors.worldPaused: The village is under maintenance. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.alreadyHasCharacter: Your soul already has a character: one person, one character.
errors.notSoulController: This account does not control your soul. Sign in again and retry.
errors.genesisFoundersOnly: During Genesis Week only Founders are born. If you hold $ALDEA, link your wallet.
errors.birthNotReady: The embers are not ready yet; a few more seconds.
errors.alreadyAnchored: Your soul was already anchored; carry on.
errors.network: Your request didn't go through. Retry.
errors.noCharacter: You don't have a character yet. Be born at the Town Center to enter buildings.
errors.notBornYet: Your soul is still arriving; wait to be born before entering.
errors.unknownBuilding: That building does not exist in this village.
errors.buildingClosed: This building is closed for now.
errors.entryNotRecorded: Your entry was not recorded on the chain. You can keep looking around.
errors.busy: The village is receiving many souls; try again in a few minutes.
errors.soulRevoked: This soul was revoked and can no longer act in the village.
errors.notAllowed: This account can't do that in the village.
errors.needsSoul: You need your soul first. Sign in and be born at the Town Center.

village.canvasLabel: The village. Arrows or WASD to walk, Tab to move from door to door, Enter to go in.
village.hint: Tap the ground or a building to walk · arrows or WASD · wheel to zoom
village.guestHint: Drag to look around · be born at the Town Center to enter the buildings
village.failed: We could not open the village on this device.
village.liteHint: This device is running slow: smoke, embers and background animations are off.

registry.title: Soul Registry
registry.noTies: This soul has not been born in the village yet.
registry.notBornYet: You haven't been born yet. The Town Center is waiting for you.
registry.closed: The Registry is closed for a moment.
registry.founderNotYet: not yet. If you hold $ALDEA, you can claim it by linking your Cardano wallet.
registry.charterNotYet: not yet. It is signed when the Council opens with the Genesis Charter.
registry.agentsSoon: Coming soon: register souls for your agents
registry.agentsSoonText: Your agents will have their own soul, tied to yours, with the same evidence on the chain.

tribe.empty: No souls in this tribe yet.

waitlist.failed: We couldn't sign you up, try again.

portal.onlyWorld: For now, ALDEA is the only world in the Atlas. Want to found the second one?
portal.notMeasurable: Activity on the chain not measurable

empty.verified: There are no verified worlds yet.
empty.all: The Atlas has no worlds yet.

travel.warning: {{world}} is not verified. Nobody has checked who runs it or what its site does.
travel.advice: Do not sign anything or enter your keys there unless you trust whoever runs it. ALDEA will never ask you for a signature to travel.
travel.understand: I understand I am leaving ALDEA for an unverified site.

council.opensOn: The Council will open with the Genesis Charter on {{date}}.
council.opensSoon: The Council will open with the Genesis Charter. The date will be announced soon.
council.whatItIs: It ratifies the village's official version: approved unless there is a qualified objection from $ALDEA holders.
council.unavailable: We couldn't read the Council. We'll try again in a moment.

what.title: What is being ratified
what.unknownVersion: The proposed version is not in the Atlas yet.

rule.title: The rule
rule.text: The Charter is approved unless there is a qualified objection: it is rejected only if the objections outweigh the signatures and also reach {{threshold}}% of the $ALDEA with a voice.
rule.otherwise: In any other case it is approved: staying silent is not objecting.
rule.weight: Each voice weighs the $ALDEA its wallet held on {{date}}.
rule.pending: The Charter's rules have not been published yet.

voice.title: Your voice
voice.signIn: Sign in with your soul to sign the Charter.
voice.notFounder: To sign the Charter you need the Founder seal.
voice.noWeight: Your wallet had no $ALDEA in the {{date}} snapshot.
voice.notOpenYet: You will be able to sign or object from {{date}}.
voice.counting: Your vote is published; it will be counted in a moment.

verify.title: Verify
verify.recompute: With the tally and its fingerprint, anyone can redo the count.

status.rejected: The Charter was rejected by a qualified objection.
status.noResult: The Charter closed with no rules published: there is no result.
status.waitingQueue: The result is about to be published on the chain.
status.queued: The result is on the chain. It can be executed from {{date}}; until then the guardian can veto it.

vote.choose: Choose the wallet you linked to your soul.
vote.aboutToSign: You are about to sign the Charter. Your wallet will show you this message:
vote.aboutToObject: You are about to object to the Charter. Your wallet will show you this message:
vote.noTransaction: It is only a signature: no transaction is built, nothing moves and there is no fee.

errors.otherWallet: That is not the wallet linked to your soul. Choose the one you linked.
errors.badSignature: The signature did not match. Sign with the wallet linked to your soul.
errors.tooMany: You changed your vote many times today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.notPublished: We couldn't publish your vote. Try again.

list.fallback: This device cannot draw the village: you are in List mode, with the same buildings and actions.

status.paused: The village is under maintenance. You can look around, but you can't be born or enter buildings for now.
status.offline: You're offline. The village is waiting for you.
status.bornFirst: First you need to be born at the Town Center.

world.notFound: We couldn't find that world in the Atlas.
world.noVersions: This world hasn't published any versions yet.
world.noClients: This world hasn't registered any clients yet.

explain.official: The Atlas confirms this is this world's official version.
explain.candidate: It is registered in the Atlas, but it is not the official one yet.

explain.unofficial: The Atlas does not recognize this client as a current version of this world.
explain.development: This is a development server: it does not come from a release.
explain.unknown: We couldn't reach the Atlas to check this version.

errors.belowMinimum: Your wallet does not hold the minimum $ALDEA for the seal.
errors.missing: You need {{amount}} more $ALDEA for the seal.
errors.readingCardano: We're reading Cardano, come back in a few minutes.
errors.alreadyFounder: Your soul already has the Founder seal.

errors.tryAgain: We couldn't claim the seal. Try again.

link.title: Link Cardano
link.noWallets: We couldn't find any Cardano wallets. Install Eternl or Lace and come back.
link.signIntro: Your wallet will show you this message. Sign it to prove the wallet is yours.
link.noTransaction: It is only a signature: no transaction is built, nothing moves and there is no fee.
link.linked: Your wallet is now linked to your soul.
link.noStakePart: This wallet has no stake part. It works, but a wallet with one is preferable.

errors.generic: We couldn't link your wallet. Try again.
errors.walletRefused: The wallet did not give access. Open it and try again.
errors.signatureRejected: You didn't sign the message. You can sign it whenever you like.
errors.linkedElsewhere: This wallet already belongs to another soul.
errors.alreadyLinked: Your soul already has a Cardano wallet linked.
errors.badSignature: The signature did not match. Sign with your wallet's stake address.
errors.expired: The request expired. Let's start again.
errors.wrongNetwork: That wallet is on another Cardano network.
errors.unsupported: That kind of address cannot be linked.

genesis.title: Founders first
genesis.explain: During Genesis Week, those who hold $ALDEA are born. If that is you, link your Cardano wallet and be born: your Founder seal is claimed in the same step.
genesis.opens: The village opens to every soul on {{date}}.
genesis.linked: Your wallet is linked. Choose your class to be born.
